purpose: Construct the provisionally separated declarative representation of the measurability relation candidate without inferring relation endpoints or metric semantics.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, required opaque input, relation object, canonical provenance, absence of inferred endpoints, and exact decision TLC-HR-0100.
Preserve TLC-SO-PRACTICE-061, input and output identities, opaque payload, provisional separation, reservations, traceability, and TLC-HR-0100.
Keep structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection available despite unresolved relation science.

forbidden.statement: Do not supply or infer relation endpoints, indicator types, metric formulas, scales, thresholds, evaluation procedures, or scientific results.
Do not merge the provisional feature boundary, replace or resolve TLC-HR-0100, invent temporal or effect semantics, or publish partial success.

deferred.statement: Endpoint identity and scientific relation evaluation remain deferred to future scientific authority.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable provisionally separated relation-candidate representation or a stable structured error.

constraints.statement: The required value is supplied under candidate status, remains opaque, and supplies no relation endpoint identity.

preconditions.statement: INPUT-PRACTICE-012-1 and TLC-SO-PRACTICE-061 are present with canonical provenance and no supplied or inferred relation endpoints.
The scientific decision set contains exactly TLC-HR-0100.

postconditions.statement: The relation identity, payload, output reference, provenance, provisional boundary, reservations, and TLC-HR-0100 remain exact and traceable.
Blocked scientific evaluation does not block successful structural representation.

invariants.statement: No relation endpoint identity is supplied or inferred.
The feature remains provisionally separated and TLC-HR-0100 remains the only decision reference.
No indicator type, metric formula, scale, threshold, evaluation method, temporal semantic, progression, or effect is inferred.

steps: validate identity input provenance no endpoints and exact decision
preserve opaque value provisional boundary and blocker

partial_order.before: validate identity input provenance no endpoints and exact decision
preserve opaque value provisional boundary and blocker

prescription_basis: No-endpoint validation, provisional-boundary preservation, exact blocker propagation, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; internal sequencing is open.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-012.
Source error id missing_required_input: INPUT-PRACTICE-012-1 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: the required value is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: the relation object or TLC-HR-0100 lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: relation identity, provisional boundary, provenance, or exact decision differs from authority.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id scientific_decision_required: scientific relation evaluation is requested before TLC-HR-0100 is resolved.
Source error id external_evaluator_required: an external scientific relation evaluation is requested without a provider after scientific resolution.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: endpoint inference, feature merging, indicator selection, metric semantics, or an undeclared operation is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the singular provisionally separated declarative representation and TLC-HR-0100.
Do not infer endpoints, select indicators, merge the feature boundary, or evaluate the relation.
Internal architecture remains free when the provisional public boundary and all observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Unresolved relation science never invalidates an otherwise valid structural representation.
Provisional separation, no-endpoint status, decision identity, candidate status, opacity, and traceability cannot be weakened.

dependencies.purpose: Stable relation, input, output, and decision identities
Preserved reservations and unresolved endpoint science

notes: Conformance is structural; relation endpoints and evaluation remain unresolved.
